newsitem.title: USA: Logicon gets contract worth some $50 mln.
newsitem.headline: Logicon gets contract worth some $50 mln.

text.p: Logicon Inc said on Monday it has been awarded a contract from Computer Sciences Corp worth about $50 million.
Logicon said it is part of a six-member team supporting the U.S. Army's electronic proving ground field office at Fort Lewis, Washington.

Logicon said, in a statement, that the contract has one base year with four option years and a potential overall value of $161 million, if all options are exercised. The estimated value to Logicon is $50 million.
Logicon is a provider of advanced technology systems and services to support national security, civil and industrial needs.
